proposed_changes.change: R1 (gate): add a signature-independent trigger -- N VETOs against one plan_path within one session, regardless of category overlap. Keep the existing signature-matched trigger. closure_enforcer: qor.scripts.veto_pattern
proposed_changes.rationale: Four VETOs carried four distinct findings signatures, so veto_pattern and cycle_count_escalator both stayed silent. A plan that fails differently each round is invisible to every detector keyed on sameness, and the silence was read as convergence in three consecutive audit reports.

proposed_changes.change: R2 (doctrine): state that the P1 citation-evidence contract binds audit reports as well as plans, and widen the checking surface to --report. GH #330's scope should include the report surface. closure_enforcer: qor.scripts.plan_grep_lint
proposed_changes.rationale: The iteration-4 VETO turned on a false file:line citation authored in the iteration-2 audit report and inherited by plan iterations 3 and 4. It propagated through four artifacts without re-execution. plan_grep_lint checks plans only, so the artifact that adjudicates citation truth is the one artifact whose citations nothing checks.

proposed_changes.change: R3 (skill): require an Option B reviewer to declare its available toolset in its first response, and forbid the Judge from pinning a verification outside that set. closure_enforcer: /qor-audit Step 1
proposed_changes.rationale: The mandated reviewer had no shell across four iterations. Every mandating finding required Judge re-derivation, two rounds of ancestor-revision claims went unverified by the mandated party, and a freeze attestation was pinned as a content hash the reviewer could not compute. A mandated reviewer that cannot execute provides a weaker guarantee than the mandate implies.

proposed_changes.change: R4 (gate): reconcile the classifier pattern set with the shadow_event schema enum -- add a pattern per event type or document why a type is deliberately non-actionable. Promote SG-TranscribedEvidence-A and SG-VacuousSelfValidation-A to structured countermeasures in the same pass. closure_enforcer: qor.scripts.remediate_pattern_match
proposed_changes.rationale: degradation, repeated_veto_pattern, gate_skipped_prerequisite_absent and governance-state-loss have no classifier pattern, so events of those types can be appended and never produce a proposal. repeated_veto_pattern is the type veto_pattern.check emits, so even a fired detector would reach a classifier with no pattern for it. Both SG candidates stand past the promotion thresholds their own entries set.
